ig._comment: What this repository's FHIR IG side is, per the content types its layers register (bean folio-assistant-cz17, follow-up b; owner card 2026-10-30T12:40Z, "A. ig section in index.config"). `ig`: fhir-harness's `ig` content type (fhir-harness#198); `include` is everything fhir-harness's IG readers read in this repository, and nothing else is read (owner, 2026-10-30: "harness desclares what it it pays attention to in the repo"). It lists every `input/` entry the build used before the section existed, so nothing is dropped. The folio (`folio/`, `review/`, `library/`, `archimate/`, `documents/`, `uploads/`) is the `dpi-h-ra` document instance's, read by its own adapter and site steps, not by this list. sushi-config.yaml stays SUSHI's file. smart-immunizations#89 is the model.
